title: airline-delays: Brazil's scheduled domestic flights 2000-2013, from ANAC's raw records to a published article's tables, its theory, and a flight-level delay predictor
description: Research compendium of Bendinelli, Bettini & Oliveira (2016, Transportation Research Part A 85, 39-52). Data: the article's estimation panel (24,589 route-months x 52 columns, curated from the authors' final base of December 2015) and the open reconstruction of ANAC's Voo Regular Ativo flight-leg records (2000-2013) into a fact table, a route-month panel and two city projections, with Frictionless Data Package metadata and a bilingual data dictionary. Code: ingestion, staging, the fact table and panel, the re-estimation of Tables 2-7, the congestion model derived symbolically, and the flight-level delay predictor. Code under MIT; curated data and text under CC BY 4.0; VRA-derived tables attributed to ANAC.

sources.title: ANAC, IAC 1504 (justification codes, DI codes, line types)
ANAC tariff microdata and statistical data (upstream of the article panel's concentration and low-cost presence variables)
OurAirports (airport coordinates behind the node map)
IBGE, Divisão Regional do Brasil (macro-regions of the seasonality dummies)
Diário Oficial da União, federal holiday laws (Lei 662/1949, Lei 10.607/2002)
Bendinelli, Bettini & Oliveira (2016), the article whose tables are replicated

fields.description: TARGET. 1 when the arrival delay exceeds 15 minutes. Null on a cancelled flight, on a realised flight with no actual arrival time (ADR-0012) and on a flight whose timestamps are suspect (ADR-0015), never zero.
fields.x-definition-pt: ALVO. 1 quando o atraso de chegada passa de 15 minutos. Nulo em voo cancelado, em voo realizado sem horário real de chegada (ADR-0012) e em voo com horário suspeito (ADR-0015), nunca zero.
fields.x-source: derived in airline_delays.prediction.dataset from data/staged and the fact table

fields.name: late30_arr
fields.title: flag
fields.description: TARGET. 1 when the arrival delay exceeds 30 minutes, ANAC's own second band.
fields.x-definition-pt: ALVO. 1 quando o atraso de chegada passa de 30 minutos, a segunda faixa da própria ANAC.
fields.x-source: derived in airline_delays.prediction.dataset from data/staged and the fact table

fields.name: arr_delay_min
fields.title: minutes
fields.description: TARGET, regression. Signed arrival delay in minutes, actual minus scheduled, early arrivals negative (ADR-0008). Suspect timestamps are already out (ADR-0015); the symmetric outlier threshold of ADR-0015 is not applied here, because trimming a regression target is the consumer's decision.
fields.x-definition-pt: ALVO de regressão. Atraso de chegada com sinal, real menos previsto, chegada adiantada negativa (ADR-0008). Horários suspeitos já saíram (ADR-0015); o corte simétrico de outlier da ADR-0015 não é aplicado aqui, porque aparar um alvo de regressão é decisão de quem consome.
fields.x-source: derived in airline_delays.prediction.dataset from data/staged and the fact table

fields.name: cancelled
fields.title: flag
fields.description: TARGET. 1 when the flight was cancelled. Defined on every row, because the table is the SCHEDULED universe, not the realised one -- this is the only target with no ADR-0012 exclusion.
fields.x-definition-pt: ALVO. 1 quando o voo foi cancelado. Definido em todas as linhas, porque a tabela é o universo PROGRAMADO e não o realizado -- é o único alvo sem exclusão da ADR-0012.
fields.x-source: derived in airline_delays.prediction.dataset from data/staged and the fact table
